name: List workspace audit logs
description: List workspace audit logs Retrieve audit logs for a specific workspace with optional filtering and pagination. GET /v1/owners/{ownerId}/audit-logs
context:
GET /v1/owners/{ownerId}/audit-logs
Retrieve audit logs for a specific workspace with optional filtering and pagination.
Required: ownerId (path) — The ID of the workspace to return resources for
Optional: startTime (query) — Start time for filtering audit logs (ISO 8601 format); endTime (query) — End time for filtering audit logs (ISO 8601 format); cursor (query) — The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).; limit (query) — The maximum number of audit log items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

name: List workspaces
description: List workspaces List the workspaces that your API key has access to, optionally filtered by name or owner email address. GET /v1/owners
context:
GET /v1/owners
List the workspaces that your API key has access to, optionally filtered by name or owner email address.
Optional: name (query) — Only return workspaces with one of the provided names. Only exact matches are returned.; email (query) — Only return workspaces owned by one of the provided email addresses.; cursor (query) — The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).
